mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in the past month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in the past three months signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past three months signals strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are positively impacted.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past month signals increased economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% each in the past month signals strong demand across multiple sectors, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as broad economic activity strengthens.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth prospects diminish.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% each in the past month signals inflationary pressure coupled with monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded and borrowing costs rise.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS both increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in GDP (GDPC1) over the past two quarters signals a weakening economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and economic growth prospects decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
